task.description:
WF-03 Step 2b: Code design validation (HARD GATE — implementation cannot start until this passes).

Read src/design/iss0209-test-api08-recovery.md.

Verify per docs/agents/shared/CHECKPOINTS.md and code-design-validator guidance:
1. python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss0209-test-api08-recovery.md — exit 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR
2. Every acceptance criterion in the diagnosis report has a corresponding design element

5. Error taxonomy exists
6. Dependencies documented
7. Files to modify with line ranges are listed

Complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without ambiguity

result.summary: ISS-0209 design artefact validated — Type E prose design covers all 5 diagnosis acceptance criteria; no implementation code present; public function signatures, error taxonomy, dependencies, and file-level line ranges all listed; classification rationale is sound.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 3) to implement the fix per design.
